analysis: The only change in docs/provider/cli-reference.md is documentation: the 'Last updated' date (line 3) and line 52, which now says GLM inline video input accepts constant or variable frame rate. No code, configuration, endpoint, authorization, attestation, key-handling or cache-policy change is present. I read the unchanged surrounding text (base lines 1672-1821, head lines 1-404) and found nothing that contradicts the retained threat model. The prefix-cache text (default-on SSD tier, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE kill switch, daemon env passthrough list) matches T-041. The App Attest worker flag (exactly '1') and the logout wording are consistent with TB-011, T-053 and A-008. Line 52 matters only indirectly. The variable-frame-rate claim implies a media decode path that was not changed in the supplied evidence. If that implementation lands elsewhere, it should be reviewed against T-050 (inline video plaintext must not go to provider temp files) and against media-parsing denial of service in TB-007. The supplied docs show no such code, so this is an unverified contract and not a finding. The doc does not state the temp-file handling, memory bounds or decoder limits for variable-frame-rate video. Integration should check that the corresponding source change keeps plaintext off disk and bounds frame counts and memory.
